body:
Remove LINQ and closures from the request localization per-request path.

## Description
- `AcceptLanguageHeaderRequestCultureProvider` replaces `Take`/`OrderByDescending`/`Select`/`ToList` with a stable ranking sort written directly into a pre-sized `List<StringSegment>` when there are 16 or fewer values. Above that it falls back to the original LINQ.
- `RequestLocalizationMiddleware` replaces the `FirstOrDefault` closures and boxed `IList` enumerators with indexed loops for `List`/array, and a `foreach` fallback for other `IList` types. No `stackalloc` or `CollectionsMarshal`.
- Adds `src/Middleware/perf/Localization.Microbenchmarks`.

Benchmark (3 interleaved A/B rounds, re-measured on the current revision):

| Benchmark | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| AcceptLanguageHeader | 865-916 ns / 1632 B | 676-719 ns / 1024 B |
| QueryString | 405-496 ns / 992 B | 379-403 ns / 832 B |
| NoCulture | 217-227 ns / 328 B | 208-244 ns / 328 B (noise) |

Tests: Localization unit 53/53 and functional 12/12. The 11 new ordering and collection-kind tests also pass on the original code.

Note: this branch and perf/cors-evaluate-allocs (#70145) both add a perf project to the same `/src/Middleware/perf/` sections of AspNetCore.slnx and Middleware.slnf. Whichever merges second needs a trivial rebase.
